narrative: An email claims you received an unexpected cashback reward.

message.body: You have an unclaimed cashback reward of ₹1,450 from your recent UPI transactions. Click below to enter your bank details and claim before link expires.

evidence.label: Request for Banking Details
evidence.value: Asks for account number and PIN to claim reward

evidence.label: PayQuick Official App Rewards Tab
evidence.value: App shows ₹0 pending rewards; legitimate cashbacks are credited automatically without requesting details.

consequence_text.safe: You checked your official banking app and confirmed no cashback claim was required.
consequence_text.unsafe: Entering bank details for fake cashback rewards grants full access to account funds.

teaching_point: Transfer strategy: Real financial rewards do not require entering secret banking details on external sites.
